name: When should I consider installing an accessible kitchen sink?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider installing an accessible kitchen sink?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider installing an accessible kitchen sink if a household member uses a wheelchair or has mobility challenges that make a standard sink difficult or unsafe to use. It's also a valuable consideration during a kitchen renovation or new construction project to ensure your home is functional for all current and future needs. Proactively making your kitchen accessible enhances independence and safety for everyone.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider installing an accessible kitchen sink if a household member uses a wheelchair or has mobility challenges, or during a kitchen renovation to enhance universal accessibility.
